compiled_state.title: [implementation-plan/migration-class]: below-threshold result emits 'inconclusive' -> conflated with sg-unavailable determination
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** feab385e17bf557c9a97fbf92fbb7def70c17ad2
* **Files:** plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh (lines ~174-177), plugins/dso/docs/contracts/migration-class-marker.md

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker / latent design gap (discovered while implementing story 7913-abe2-de0e-45e3 task 46a0-6ce2-100a-4e55 in epic dso-uvyl)

#### Expected Behavior
The migration-class marker should let consumers distinguish three semantically different outcomes: (a) determined NOT a migration sweep (sg available, call-site count below threshold), (b) determined a sweep, (c) could-not-determine (sg unavailable or no target symbol). dd-7 mandates the could-not-determine case be an explicit 'inconclusive' that is 'never silently false'.

#### Actual Behavior
migration-class-marker.md defines exactly three values: sweep | db | inconclusive — with no distinct 'not-a-migration / none' value. Consequently migration-class-detect.sh emits 'inconclusive' for BOTH (a) below-threshold-with-sg-available (a real determination) AND (c) sg-unavailable / empty target symbol (couldn't determine). A consumer (sprint two-pass ordering, task-decomposer) reading 'inconclusive' cannot tell 'this story needs no migration handling' from 'detection failed, needs attention'. This conflation weakens the dd-7 'never silently false' intent even though dd-7's narrow test (sg-unavailable -> inconclusive) still passes.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* Contract: plugins/dso/docs/contracts/migration-class-marker.md (task d10e, closed).
* Producer: migration-class-detect.sh (task 46a0).

#### Suggested direction (non-binding)
Add a fourth marker value (e.g. 'none' or 'not-migration') to the contract for the 'sg available, determined below threshold and not db' case; reserve 'inconclusive' strictly for could-not-determine (sg-unavailable / no symbol). Update the detect script branch at lines ~174-177 to emit the new value, and update the contract doc + the detect test accordingly. Coordinate with the sibling consumer stories (task-decomposer emission, sprint two-pass) so they branch on the richer value set.

comments.body: Fixed by epic dso-uvyl deep-review remediation (merged to main, v1.17.117): below-threshold detection now emits a distinct 'none' marker value (detection ran, below threshold / not migration-class) instead of overloading 'inconclusive' (which is reserved for sg-unavailable). Contract (migration-class-marker.md) + consumers (task-decomposer.md, apply-two-pass-ordering.sh) updated.
